name: Light
description: A Light represents a Lighting source.

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: Relevant only for Rect and Spot LightTypes

parameters.name: inner_cone_angle_percent
parameters.description: Inner Cone Angle Percent (Relevant only for Spot LightType) (0-1)

parameters.name: max_draw_distance
parameters.description: Max Draw Distance (Good for performance) - 0 for infinite

parameters.name: use_inverse_squared_falloff
parameters.description: Whether to use physically based inverse squared distance falloff, where Attenuation Radius is only clamping the light's contribution. (Spot and Point types only)

parameters.name: source_radius
parameters.description: Radius of light source shape. (Spot and Point types only)

parameters.name: spawn_mode
parameters.description: Pass SpawnMode.AfterConstructor or SpawnMode.Manual to avoid immediately sending the entity to clients and improve performance when you want to configure it by setting several configs. Must call FinishSpawn() after all

functions.name: SetCastShadows
functions.description: Sets if this Light casts shadows

functions.name: SetIntensity
functions.description: Sets the brightness of this Light

functions.name: SetAttenuationRadius
functions.description: Sets the distance this Light reaches

functions.name: GetCastShadows
functions.description: Gets if this Light casts shadows

functions.name: GetIntensity
functions.description: Gets the brightness of this Light

functions.name: GetAttenuationRadius
functions.description: Gets the distance this Light reaches

functions.name: GetColor
functions.description: Gets the color of this Light
